acceptanceDesign.factBasedCompletion: Acceptance belongs to each actual instance/direction/variant and activated capability: reverse identity and source, specific amount quote, emitted quoted/runtime execution where supported, actual debit/receipt, old-inventory and safety negatives. A generic module or JSON field existing is never sufficient.
acceptanceDesign.migrationEquivalence: Reuse existing production issuers, amount quote API and emitted-program executors with identical source state, input, recipient, direction and failure case before/after. Do not substitute a new JSON-only testing implementation.

audits.sourceScope: Parent verified relevant cloud source hashes match this local snapshot; defaults below are production source defaults, not current live environment overrides.

summary.currentRegistration: All 11 still register handwritten family TS modules through defineProtocolFamily.
summary.migrationConclusion: All can be candidates for JSON definitions plus shared Family TS, with pure protocol mathematics separate. The current ERC4626 public compiler cannot express all existing semantics; shared primitives must be added and verified before deleting dedicated code. Moving a family TS wrapper behind JSON is not completion.

sharedExisting.capability: Root/child JSON variants and unique variant matching
Identity stage selection, requests/decode/decision; reuse instead of creating a new state machine
Closed value operations include map/filter/every, ABI encode/decode, source/effects/tokenDelta/event/requestFailure; existing generic behavior assertions are reusable
Execution common approval, call result save/check, full debit/fresh receipt and old inventory protection; return-code zero can be expressed without a Compound-specific error module
Quote request declarations already accept multiple same-round requests; do not describe this as one-RPC-only

sharedGaps.need: Call/log argument and actor projection, evidence-key versus instance-key separation, declarative path predicates; current discovery only nominates the call target/address.

Bounded continuation/DAG where an earlier result determines the next quote input; same-round multiple requests are already supported. Current pricing/exact decode initialResults and require a distinguished source-bound quote row.

Typed pure math providers and snapshot-to-quote support, preserving source/rounding/capacity. Share protocol math between exact/quoted/runtime without accepting arbitrary executable imports from JSON.
Per-kind log/call addresses and field predicates shared by indexed and fallback paths; preserve oracle calls and Transfer participant filters. Current fallback only handles log observations.
Bounded transfer/approve/call sequences and multi-asset debit/credit effects; current conversion requires one full debit and one fresh receipt and has one main call.
Typed runtime arrays/tuples/bytes and scalar runtime-math result arguments, with compiler-owned offsets and resource budgets.
Explicit positive bounded actual debit, maximum budget, leftover protection/refund semantics independent of one-wei tolerance; full-input debit is not correct for all variants.
Declared quote-output/deferred-input, authenticated callback context and debt/continuation, native wrap/unwrap conservation where applicable. Current schema only consumes direct-output.

schemaEvolutionAndAcceptance.newModuleDefault: Absent newly introduced optional module is missing/unverified, never auto-implemented or auto-passed. Existing supported paths may keep working. A requested path requiring that missing module must reject precisely.
schemaEvolutionAndAcceptance.requiredness: Required fields depend on declared capability and already-supported scope, not merely the latest template containing a slot. Migration must not erase existing runtime/recipient/callback capabilities by marking them missing.
schemaEvolutionAndAcceptance.generation: A version-aware normalizer can emit a uniform latest schema with explicit empty new slots and a capability-gap report; it must preserve values and extensions, reject incompatible semantics, and never fabricate ABI or behavior proof.
schemaEvolutionAndAcceptance.errors: JSON may declare named expected result/revert codes and rejection classifications. Shared TS validates and maps them; transport failure remains distinct. Do not equate a schema-populated error field with a verified rejection path.
schemaEvolutionAndAcceptance.acceptance: Actual reverse identity and source-bound quote + quoted execution + runtime actual receipts for supported variants are facts to preserve/verify. Schema completeness is not protocol acceptance. New empty modules are not backfilled as success.
